domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare operands for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into a subtraction-ready form by normalizing whole or mixed numbers and/or establishing compatible denominators or fractional structure before subtraction.
skills.merge_rationale: Inherited from the K=4 level. These skills remain naturally grouped as pre-subtraction setup operations.

skills.name: Execute subtraction with regrouping when needed
skills.definition: Perform subtraction on aligned whole and fractional parts, including borrowing across the whole-number part when the fractional part is insufficient.
skills.merge_rationale: S04 is a conditional extension of S03 during execution: borrowing occurs only when straightforward subtraction of aligned parts produces an insufficient fractional part. In the dossiers, regrouping is embedded directly after attempted subtraction (e.g., FS07, FS10), making these two skills part of the same execution phase. Merging them is appropriate at a coarser level because regrouping is not a separate preparation or finalization domain.

skills.name: Finalize and simplify result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in simplest valid form, including reducing fractions and simplifying to a whole number or zero when appropriate.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because final simplification still provides distinct diagnostic information even in a coarse codebook.
